system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Lambda function triggered by SQS queue for order processing'

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor
    Description: Name of the Lambda function

Resources:
  OrderProcessorLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SQSPollingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn

  OrderQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-queue'
      VisibilityTimeoutSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import boto3
          
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Processing {len(event['Records'])} SQS messages")
              
              for record in event['Records']:
                  try:
                      message_body = record['body']
                      logger.info(f"Processing message: {message_body}")
                      
                      # Process order logic here
                      # Example: parse JSON, validate, store in database, etc.
                      
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error(f"Error processing message: {str(e)}")
                      # Message will be retried based on SQS redrive policy
                      raise
                      
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'processedMessages': len(event['Records'])}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderQueue

  OrderProcessorEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5

Outputs:
  FunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FunctionName'
      
  QueueURL:
    Description: URL of the SQS queue
    Value: !Ref OrderQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueURL'
      
  QueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueArn'
